about_the_game:
Home Paige is a momentum-based 3D platformer set inside a 90s Operating System. You play as Paige, a silly, optimistic girl from your computer! ⭐

Paige has lived in The RECYCLING BIN her whole life; a worthless place where useless people go to get deleted. She’s learned not to get attached, because why would you if everyone disappears?

In this narrative-driven game, you’ll meet all sorts of odd characters who live in this OS world and immerse yourself in a world full of strange foods, NPCs, shopkeepers, rivals, and friends.

The locations are all offbeat, but comforting and immersive... you may truly feel a part of them. Enjoy a rich world inspired by the old Internet and the optimism of the 2000s era of design.
